test.command: python -m pytest tests/test_forward_paper_account_bridge.py tests/test_forward_book_adapter.py tests/test_forward_session_runner.py tests/test_forward_feed_health.py -q; python -m ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/paper_account_bridge.py src/financial_brain/forward_edge/session_runner.py tests/test_forward_paper_account_bridge.py; python -m mypy src/financial_brain/forward_edge/paper_account_bridge.py src/financial_brain/forward_edge/session_runner.py

implemented: Exchange-session calendar is content-addressed and validates unique ordered dates.
Frozen holding horizon resolves from entry session across weekends and holidays; midnight does not reset it.
Book adapter emits scheduled exit date and SCHEDULED/DUE/OVERDUE state as normalized position events.
ForwardPaperSessionService.run_with_daily_book constructs BOOK_POSITION events from the persisted daily book using the supplied exchange calendar and runner clock.

Registered ForwardPaperSessionService routes one visible due/overdue position event through the sealed decision, configured risk callback, quote-based simulator, durable order lifecycle, and cash-account reconciliation.
The close route validates event visibility, frozen instrument eligibility, and exact account inventory quantity; invalid or mismatched evidence fails closed.
Explicit reduction/close decisions bypass entry-only alpha, pretrade, and family-enrollment gates while retaining feed-health and configured risk checks.
Multiple due exits fail closed because the runner currently accepts one intent per session.
blockers: An authoritative effective-dated exchange calendar feed is not wired; the caller must supply the calendar.
The single-intent session runner cannot execute multiple due exits in one session.
No prospective overnight market session has validated the end-to-end exit behavior.
